objects.original: Finite-dimensional real inner-product normed E, its Borel measurable structure, actual standard Gaussian gamma_E, and real L2 equivalence classes.
objects.reconstructed: The reconstruction explicitly names the same compatible real Hilbert geometry, Gaussian probability and quotient L2 carrier.
objects.evidence: The five structure binders match the source objects; no replacement measure or unrelated feature carrier appears.

domains.original: Every natural j, including zero, and every ambient w; values are in actual L2(gamma_E).
domains.reconstructed: N={0,1,...}, all w in E, with precisely that quotient-space codomain.
domains.evidence: The type and literal body together preserve both arguments and target measure.

quantifiers.original: A family defined for every j,w after fixing the carrier structures.
quantifiers.reconstructed: A parameterized definition N -> E -> L2, with body fixing each value.
quantifiers.evidence: This is a definition, not an existential feature family or a theorem with assumed covariance.

assumptions.original: The fixed geometric/Borel structures; membership is supplied by the proved polynomial theorem.
assumptions.reconstructed: The real coefficient image of H_j is evaluated literally, and its supplied membership witness forms the class.
assumptions.evidence: No regularity, unit-vector or Gram hypothesis is added; proof irrelevance ensures membership-proof choice does not choose a different class.

conclusion.original: h_j(w) is the class of x -> H_j(<w,x>), with unnormalized probabilists Hermite.
conclusion.reconstructed: The body is that exact class, after canonical integer-to-real coefficient mapping; it distinguishes body from type alone.
conclusion.evidence: The independently reviewed literal body and compiler meaning output agree. The recurrence in the reconstruction explicates the named probabilists normalization.

scopes.original: Actual equivalence class for all ambient directions; no pointwise representative convention or different-carrier identification.
scopes.reconstructed: Brackets denote a.e. classes of the displayed functions; the value is fixed by the body.
scopes.evidence: The reconstruction adds no stronger representative or feature-isometry assertion.

constant_dependencies.original: Unnormalized H_j, whose standard Gaussian normalization is j!; no coefficient normalization premise.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: H0=1, H1=t and the probabilists recurrence fix the same normalization.
constant_dependencies.evidence: There is no 1/sqrt(j!) factor in the body or reconstruction. This definition earns no theorem credit.
